# semaphore_ex_audit_webhook_signing_revoke_next (Action)

Explicitly advances audit webhook signing state using the exact server signing revision.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "semaphore_ex_audit_webhook_signing_revoke_next" "cancel" {
  config {
    expected_signing_revision = semaphore_ex_audit_webhook.audit.signing_revision
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `expected_signing_revision` (Number)
